title: Peunajoh Ureueng Tuha Nyang Hana Teuduga
intro: Lam kawasan suci Baét Allah, sidroe hamba Allah nyang ka tuha geualami saboh misteri nyang that meudalam nyang meulawan ngon mandum harapan. Individu nyang seutia nyoe, ka treb that ka leupah thon-thon keu ureung tuha alami, geusaksikan sesuatu nyang luar biasa nyang geupeuleumah rahmat Ilahi nyang hana bataih. Teka-teki nyan na bak tapeuhah momen nyang ka tuwoe nyoe nibak udep nabi-nabi.
clues: Umat ​​Ulôn jituri sibagoe Israel, keuturonan sidroe indatu nyang rayeuk yoh masa ilée.
Malam-malam ulôn lôn peuguna lam doá, lôn sujud dikeue Tuhan ulôn lam Baét TUHAN.
Lon geubri sidroe aneuk agam bak masa tuha, hadiah nyang hana lon putôh-putôh lon peumulia Allah.
Sidang lon melibatkan menemukan rezeki yang muncul untuk jiwa muda dimiyub perawatan lon.
Lon nakeuh sidroe nabi nyang nan jih Zakariyya, geubri tugaih untuk geujaga Maryam di Baytil Maqdis.
Jawaban jih na lam ayat dipat Allah geuteurimong Maryam dan geubri rezeki keu Maryam.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Nabi yang jaga Maryam di kuil .
Nabi nyang peudong rumoh suci .
Nabi geutelan le eungkot rayeuk .
Nabi nyang plueng nibak umatgeuh .
Nabi nyang peugah haba langsong ngon Allah .
identity.answer: Nabi yang jaga Maryam di kuil .

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Teungoh geu uji ngon thon-thon musibah .
Meuteumeung rezeki nyang misterius disediakan keu saboh ward muda .
Dakwah keu bansa nyang jitulak peutunyok ilahi .
Dibôh lam lueng lé ureuëng droë .
Teurimong wahyu rot wahyu .
trial.answer: Meuteumeung rezeki nyang misterius disediakan keu saboh ward muda .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh kapai nyang geupeugot nibak papan ngon paku .
Baét Suci Yerusalem .
Saboh taman nyang ka reuloh .
Saboh banda nyang geupeudong lé sidroe raja nyang ade .
Dalam laôt raya .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Ureueng nyan jipatéh laju jiseutöt utusan nyan .
Teurimong dan rahmat ilahi keu ureueng nyang bakti bak ibadah .
Teuka siksaan ateueh ureueng-ureueng nyang kaphé .
Sidroe aneuk agam lahe bak masa tuha lagee janji .
Aman rot padang pasir .
outcome.answer: Teurimong dan rahmat ilahi keu ureueng nyang bakti bak ibadah .

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
